006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.time.Period;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.YearMonthDurationItemImpl;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
015import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * An atomic Metapath item containing a duration data value in years, months,
020 * and days.
021 */
022public interface IYearMonthDurationItem extends IDurationItem {
023  /**
024   * Get the type information for this item.
025   *
026   * @return the type information
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IYearMonthDurationItem> type() {
030    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.YEAR_MONTH_DURATION.getItemType();
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IYearMonthDurationItem> getType() {
035    return type();
036  }
037
038  /**
039   * Construct a new year month day duration item using the provided string
040   * {@code value}.
041   *
042   * @param value
043   *          a string representing a year month day duration
044   * @return the new item
045   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
046   *           if the provided string value is not a day/time duration value
047   *           according to ISO 8601
048   */
049  @NonNull
050  static IYearMonthDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
051    try {
052      Period period = ObjectUtils.notNull(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.YEAR_MONTH_DURATION.parse(value).withDays(0));
053      return valueOf(period);
054    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
055      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
056          null,
057          String.format("Invalid year/month duration value '%s'.",
058              value),
059          ex);
060    }
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Construct a new year month day duration item using the provided
065   * {@code value}.
066   *
067   * @param value
068   *          a duration
069   * @return the new item
070   */
071  @NonNull
072  static IYearMonthDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull Period value) {
073    return new YearMonthDurationItemImpl(ObjectUtils.notNull(value.withDays(0)));
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Construct a new year month day duration item using the provided values.
078   *
079   * @param years
080   *          the number of years in the period
081   * @param months
082   *          the number of months in the period
083   * @return the new item
084   */
085  @NonNull
086  static IYearMonthDurationItem valueOf(int years, int months) {
087    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(Period.of(years, months, 0)));
088  }
089
090  /**
091   * Get the "wrapped" duration value.
092   *
093   * @return the underlying duration value
094   */
095  @NonNull
096  Period asPeriod();
097
098  /**
099   * Get the total quantity of months this duration represents.
100   *
101   * @return the total months
102   */
103  default long asTotalMonths() {
104    return asPeriod().toTotalMonths();
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Returns a new instance with each amount in this period negated.
109   *
110   * @return the new negated instance
111   */
112  @NonNull
113  default IYearMonthDurationItem negate() {
114    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asPeriod().negated()));
115  }
116
117  /**
118   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
119   *
120   * @param item
121   *          the item to cast
122   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
123   *         cast to this type
124   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
125   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
126   */
127  @NonNull
128  static IYearMonthDurationItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
129    try {
130      return item instanceof IYearMonthDurationItem
131          ? (IYearMonthDurationItem) item
132          : valueOf(item.asString());
133    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
134      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
135      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
136    }
137  }
138
139  @Override
140  default IYearMonthDurationItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
141    return cast(item);
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Compares this value with the argument.
146   *
147   * @param item
148   *          the item to compare with this value
149   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
150   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
151   */
152  default int compareTo(IYearMonthDurationItem item) {
153    Period thisPeriod = asPeriod().normalized();
154    Period thatPeriod = item.asPeriod().normalized();
155
156    int result = Integer.compare(thisPeriod.getYears(), thatPeriod.getYears());
157    return result == 0 ? Integer.compare(thisPeriod.getMonths(), thatPeriod.getMonths()) : result;
158  }
159}
